item.title: Frontend Developer — FundedNext
item.description: As an initial core frontend team member at FundedNext, I helped build and maintain the frontend systems that power one of the largest prop trading firms. My work focused on creating responsive trader dashboards, live performance visualizations, challenge tracking interfaces, and smooth user interactions — all optimized for global users across devices.
